svg.title: Drobo 5N console header J2
svg.text: J2 is the console (UART0): BootROM, U-Boot and Linux ttyS0.
3.3 V logic, 115200 8N1. Four bare holes with no header fitted;
pin 1 has the square pad. Solder wires on and route them out of the case.
J3, the factory-fitted header, is UART1 (the stock Linux console).
It's not the one you want.
